opportunities.name: Hunt shield refresh
opportunities.objective: Use champion attacks during R to reopen E defensively.
opportunities.mechanic: R attacks against champions subtract 0.5 seconds from basic cooldowns. Navori also reduces remaining basic cooldowns through attacks; W grants speed and E restores AD/AP-scaled health after blocking a spell. This route tests faster E access with crit supporting W's explicitly critical bounces.
opportunities.requiredState: R active, real champion attacks and an incoming blockable spell after E refresh.
opportunities.failure: Peel prevents attacks or the spell shield is mistimed, losing the heal.
opportunities.test: Measure E cooldown after a fixed number of attacks with R and Navori independently enabled.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Ricochet's extra bounces are not automatically additional R cooldown-subtracting attacks.

opportunities.name: Boomerang AP guard
opportunities.objective: Test AP on the two-pass Q and blocked-spell recovery.
opportunities.mechanic: Q includes 0.6 AP inside a crit-stat multiplier expression while E healing includes 0.5 AP. Gunblade and Cosmic supply mixed damage/access, Deathcap improves these AP terms and Navori adds crit plus attack-led Q/E recovery. Ordinary Q is still physical damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Both Q passes intersect the target and actual attacks reduce cooldowns between casts.
opportunities.failure: Low sustained AD/crit attack damage or a missed return pass erases the AP tradeoff.
opportunities.test: Measure outbound/return Q and E heal at fixed AP/crit values, logging the raw multiplier separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: An explicit crit-stat scaling term is not evidence that Q randomly crits like an attack.

ruledOut.reason: The inspected E restores health and triggers Fleet of Foot; it does not state a mana refund.

unknowns: Q crit-stat multiplier semantics and bounce interaction with attack cooldown effects need live checks.

testPlan: Required state: R active, real champion attacks and an incoming blockable spell after E refresh.
Measure E cooldown after a fixed number of attacks with R and Navori independently enabled.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Peel prevents attacks or the spell shield is mistimed, losing the heal.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Ricochet's extra bounces are not automatically additional R cooldown-subtracting attacks.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Navori Flickerblade, Infinity Edge, Bloodthirster, Stormrazor, Lord Dominik's Regards, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed for [8 / 10 / 12] seconds.

Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by [0.5] seconds.

Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.

For the next [4] seconds, Sivir gains [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × 100]% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing [(0.4 / 0.425 / 0.45 / 0.475 / 0.5) × AD] physical damage each bounce for up to [8] bounces.

These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.

Sivir creates a magical barrier for [1.5] seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores [(0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × AD + (0.5) × AP] health and triggers Fleet of Foot.
